cross_check: Resting cascade (JCDR) is far below active maxima (PMC): resting PIP 39-45 deg vs max 92-97 deg -> natural poses use under half of range.
JCDR: MCP drives tapping while PIP/DIP extend and absorb -> tap motion keyed at MCP.
Animator Island asymmetry rule agrees with the cascade: fingers should not share one shape or one angle.
applied: Product video hand (scan + DEF/CTRL rig): five rounds matched to the user's own hand photos; final rest pose middle 55/95/55, ring 68/100/60, little 80/105/65, index 12/28/12 deg, thumb MCP 35 IP 25 deg, whole-hand roll removed (was 25 deg, wrong), thumb first bone lowered 22 deg palmward; supports are curled middle fingertip and thumb tip. Checked by top, side and fingertip-side close renders only.

correction_2026_11_21: Rule 5 in 6f87106 (roll the whole hand 20-30 deg toward the thumb) was a misreading of the user's photo. The user pointed it out; re-reading the TOAnimate image showed the back of the hand arches (thumb metacarpal drops palmward, knuckle line curves). Manual now says do not roll the whole hand; lower the thumb's first bone instead.
